lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the suite isn't green: 3 tests in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` fail ("formats DST boundary in America/New_York", "parses local midnight", "rolls over month end in local tz").

My check that these failures predate the bump is not valid. `git stash` only reverts tracked files like `package.json` and the lockfile, and `node_modules` normally stays at 4.17.21. The environment also reports this directory isn't a git repo, so the stash may have done nothing. Either way, the second run used the same lodash, and its identical result proves nothing.

They look unrelated to lodash, since they are timezone-dependent date tests and lodash has no date handling. That is an inference, not something I confirmed. They may fail because the machine's `TZ` isn't `America/New_York`.

To confirm, run `npm install lodash@4.17.15 && npm test`, or run the suite with `TZ=America/New_York npm test`. I haven't done either. I also didn't check that `package.json` still shows 4.17.21 after the `git stash pop`, so check that too.
